question: Which famous Indian author of 21st century wrote the novel 'The Immortals of Meluha (Shiva Trilogy)' ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amish Tripathi.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The correct answer is option 3, Amish Tripathi.**
 
• Amish Tripathi is a famous Indian author who wrote the** Shiva Trilogy, which includes the novels 'The Immortals of Meluha', 'The Secret of the Nagas', and 'The Oath of the Vayuputras'.**
 
• **'The Immortals of Meluha' **is the first novel in the trilogy and was published in 2010. It is a work of historical fiction that reimagines the Hindu god Shiva as a mortal man named Shiva who is the savior of the land of Meluha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Durjoy Datta is a contemporary Indian author known for his romantic novels such as 'Of Course I Love You' and 'Someone Like You'.
 
• Ravinder Singh is also a contemporary Indian author known for his romantic novels such as 'I Too Had a Love Story' and 'Can Love Happen Twice?'.
 
• Shashi Tharoor is a well-known Indian politician, diplomat, and author who has written several books including 'The Great Indian Novel' and 'An Era of Darkness: The British Empire in India'.
